mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is declining, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1260.0 thousand units indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1260.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (below 3.0%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL above 255.0) indicates a 'higher for longer' monetary policy stance that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market pricing for prolonged high rates intensifies.
failure_condition: In instances where FEDFUNDS < 3.0 and CPIAUCSL > 255.0, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE below 4.0%), tight labor market conditions support consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.0, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index above 109.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity and supply chain strength, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is rising, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales volume exceeding 525,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer spending momentum, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates robust corporate earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong employment growth (PAYEMS above 150,000 thousand) and declining unemployment (UNRATE below 3.8%) indicates a rapidly tightening labor market that typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings growth accelerate.
failure_condition: In instances where PAYEMS > 150000.0 and UNRATE < 3.8, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 255.0 indicates elevated inflation, which typically triggers a hawkish monetary policy response leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 255.0, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.
